captures.description: Damascus Dancings correctly identified as author. 'This refers to the speculative conceptual work and writing by the somatic phenomenologist Damascus Dancings. Her writings, notably The Commission of the Immanent Turning, explore the body's innate knowledge and how the nervous system reacts under extractive or precarious conditions.' Connected to 'Crimson Hexagon, which studies how language, meaning, and somatics interact.' Zenodo Visual Schema and SciLynk Epistle Triptych in organic.
